items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Snooky was in there, yeah, out of Dayton, Ohio.

ctx.x: Earl called it that way, and he makes the modulation, and he go a half a step up until he can revert right back to E flat and take it out. He was a master. He knew his instrument. He could play. But he couldn't understand it. But that's what he was doing, and the general public don't know it. He was a musician's musician. Musician can love it, but the paying customer, say, now what is he doing?
Well now, there was just one other person, before we leave, Lionel -- did Snooky Young come up then when you were there?
Snooky was in there, yeah, out of Dayton, Ohio.
